candidates.change_summary: Replace the EmergencyOracle constructor argument so the created oracle is owned by contract C instead of the msg.sender, changing the owner address stored in the emitted NewEmergencyOracle event and the oracle's owner.
Insert a transferOwnership call on the newly created oracle to set its owner to msg.sender (after construction), altering the oracle's owner stored state compared to original.
Replace the emitted event's first argument to be address(this) instead of msg.sender, changing the externally observable event data after oracle creation.
Replace the onlyAdmin modifier's require check to use tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing who can call newEmergencyOracle and thus which newOracle gets created.
Invert the onlyAdmin require condition to allow only non-admins, which alters whether calls to newEmergencyOracle succeed and thus whether newOracle is created.
